gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects with high-grade glioma diagnosed pathologically (referring to grade 3 or 4 in the "WHO (2021) Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System"), who have progressive disease during standard treatment or have recurrence after standard treatment.

candidate_evidence.quote: MT027: CRISPR/Cas9 edited B7H3-specific allogeneic CAR-T cells

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Study of MT027 in Patients with Recurrent or Progressive High-grade Glioma

role_evidence.quote: MT027: CRISPR/Cas9 edited B7H3-specific allogeneic CAR-T cells

agents.drug_class_hint: MT027: CRISPR/Cas9-edited B7-H3-specific allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy

source_quote.quote: The tumor tissue of the patient has positive expression of B7-H3.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named anywhere; only WHO 2021 grade 3 or 4 high-grade glioma, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. The only intervention is an allogeneic B7-H3 CAR-T cell product (excluded intervention type). B7-H3 eligibility matches the CAR-T target but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Official title mentions PK of MT027 (cell product, not a candidate; sample not stated). Lymphodepletion is mentioned only in exclusion criteria and is not a registered intervention, so not listed.
